mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SAVINGS_PRODUCT ( company_code, product_code, product_name, product_type, min_amount, max_amount, feature, target, interest_pay_type, detail_url, status ) VALUES ( #{companyCode}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{productType}, #{minAmount}, #{maxAmount}, #{feature}, #{target}, #{interestPayType}, #{detailUrl}, #{status} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE product_name = VALUES(product_name), product_type = VALUES(product_type), max_amount = VALUES(max_amount), feature = VALUES(feature), target = VALUES(target), interest_pay_type = VALUES(interest_pay_type), status = VALUES(status), product_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(product_id)
mapper.select: SELECT product_id AS productId, company_code AS companyCode, product_code AS productCode, product_name AS productName, product_type AS productType, min_amount AS minAmount, max_amount AS maxAmount, feature, target, interest_pay_type AS interestPayType, detail_url AS detailUrl, status FROM SAVINGS_PRODUCT WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 10

SELECT rate_id AS rateId, product_id AS productId, save_term AS saveTerm, min_rate AS minRate, max_rate AS maxRate, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate FROM SAVINGS_RATE WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY save_term ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscription ( deposit_id, product_id, status, start_date, end_date, account_no, applied_rate, monthly_amount, user_save_term, user_save_type, payment_day, created_at ) VALUES ( #{depositId}, #{productId}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{accountNo}, #{appliedRate}, #{monthlyAmount}, #{userSaveTerm}, #{userSaveType}, #{paymentDay}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT rate_id AS rateId, product_id AS productId, save_term AS saveTerm, min_rate AS minRate, max_rate AS maxRate, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate FROM SAVINGS_RATE WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND save_term = #{saveTerm} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYMENT ( subscription_id, round_no, amount, paid_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{subscriptionId}, #{roundNo}, #{amount}, #{paidAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(paid_at AS CHAR), 1, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AS payYear, CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(paid_at AS CHAR), 5, 2) AS UNSIGNED) AS payMonth, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM PAYMENT WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} GROUP BY payYear, payMonth ORDER BY payYear ASC, payMonth ASC

SELECT s.*, p.product_name AS productName, p.company_code AS companyCode, p.max_amount AS maxAmount, p.min_amount AS minAmount FROM SUBSCRIPTION s INNER JOIN SAVINGS_PRODUCT p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE s.subscription_id = #{subscriptionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId}
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id AS paymentId, subscription_id AS subscriptionId, round_no AS roundNo, amount, paid_at AS paidAt FROM PAYMENT WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} ORDER BY paid_at ASC
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM PAYMENT WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} AND CAST(paid_at AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION SET monthly_amount = #{newAmount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_type AS productType, p.company_code AS companyCode, MAX(r.max_rate) AS maxRate FROM SAVINGS_PRODUCT p JOIN SAVINGS_RATE r ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE p.status = 10 AND p.product_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productType}, '%') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_type, p.company_code ORDER BY maxRate DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUBSCRIPTION WHERE deposit_id = #{depositId} AND status = 10
SELECT s.subscription_id FROM SUBSCRIPTION s JOIN deposit_account d ON s.deposit_id = d.deposit_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status != 90 ORDER BY s.subscription_id DESC LIMIT 1
